articles.title: Amusement Products Returns to Gas-Powered Go-Karts with New Octane Model
articles.summary: Amusement Products has introduced the Octane, a new commercial-grade gas-powered go-kart aimed at operators who prefer the performance and simplicity of traditional fuel-powered racing. The launch signals a counter-trend to the electric kart movement, giving FEC operators another viable option for their racing attractions. Facilities evaluating or refreshing their kart fleets now have an expanded lineup to consider from this established supplier.

articles.title: KCC Entertainment Design's Mega City FEC Shortlisted for Best FEC at Park World Excellence Awards
articles.summary: Mega City, a multi-floor FEC on Slough High Street designed by KCC Entertainment Design, has been shortlisted for Best FEC at the 2026 Park World Excellence Awards. The venue repurposed a former retail space into a seamless entertainment destination featuring ten bowling lanes, 130-plus arcade machines, laser tag, laser raid, and batting cages across three floors. The project is a strong case study for FEC operators looking to activate dead retail real estate with a curated, all-day guest journey.

articles.title: Chuck E. Cheese Adventure World Makes International Debut in Mexico
articles.summary: Chuck E. Cheese has launched its Adventure World concept internationally for the first time, opening a location in Mexico. The expansion signals growing confidence in the branded FEC model beyond the U.S. market and could indicate further international franchise growth for the brand. FEC operators and investors should watch how the Adventure World format performs abroad as a bellwether for IP-driven family entertainment scaling.

articles.title: 501 FUN Debuts Virtual Archery Social Entertainment System at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026
articles.summary: 501 FUN is unveiling Virtual Archery at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026, a technology-driven attraction designed for competitive social play in entertainment venues. Players use a real bow to shoot virtual arrows at a projected screen, with motion detection and automatic scoring creating a group-competitive format. FEC operators looking for fresh social entertainment anchors that are low-footprint and accessible should take note of this launch.

articles.title: Launch Entertainment to Open Trampoline, Arcade, and Duckpin Bowling Venue at Texas Mall
articles.summary: Launch Entertainment is planning a new location at Golden Triangle Mall in Denton, Texas, combining trampolines, an arcade, and duckpin bowling under one roof. The venue is part of a broader trend of FEC operators backfilling struggling mall spaces with activity-based entertainment. The Denton opening is a useful benchmark for operators evaluating mixed-format FEC concepts in mid-size markets.

articles.title: Inside Pensacola's Massive New Launch Entertainment Complex
articles.summary: A new Launch Entertainment complex in Pensacola has been previewed, offering a large-scale look at what the trampoline and active entertainment chain is building in secondary markets. The tour reveals the scope and attraction mix the brand is deploying, providing useful competitive intelligence for regional FEC operators. Launch's continued expansion underscores the resilience of the active entertainment segment.

articles.title: iP2 and DreamWorks Animation Develop Scalable Model for Urban Family Entertainment
articles.summary: iP2 Group has partnered with DreamWorks Animation to create a scalable, IP-driven urban family entertainment model, building on iP2's existing work with Walltopia and other operators. The collaboration aims to bring DreamWorks characters and storytelling into compact, high-performance FEC formats suitable for urban locations. For FEC developers and operators, this represents a new licensing pathway to premium IP in smaller footprint venues.

articles.title: iP2 and Walltopia Launch Compact Turnkey 'Mini Theme Park' FEC Solution
articles.summary: iP2 Group and Walltopia have created a turnkey mini theme park product based on the ZAFARI IP, designed to fit into spaces of 500 to 1,000 square metres. The all-in-one solution combines climbing walls, themed attractions, and IP licensing, targeting operators who want a differentiated, franchise-ready FEC without a large footprint. This is directly relevant to operators and developers seeking plug-and-play concepts for smaller or urban locations.

articles.title: Valo Motion Founder Receives IATP Pioneer Award as Company Marks 10th Anniversary
articles.summary: Dr. Raine Kajastila, founder and CEO of Valo Motion, was honored with the 2026 IATP Pioneer Award at the association's annual conference in Florida. The recognition coincides with Valo Motion's tenth anniversary and the launch of two new products, Groundfall and ValoBoard, expanding its interactive physical activity platform. Trampoline park and active entertainment operators should be aware of these new product options as they refresh or expand their attraction mix.

articles.title: Ripley's Venture Realm Launches Mixed Reality Experience Exclusively Outside Asia
articles.summary: Ripley's Aquarium of the Smokies has launched Venture Realm, a new mixed reality experience featuring the Enterverse Cosmos library — the only location outside Asia to offer it. The attraction positions location-based mixed reality as a differentiation tool for established entertainment venues looking to add tech-forward experiences. FEC operators considering VR and MR attractions should note this as a case study in exclusive content licensing for LBE.

articles.title: Six Flags Acquires Fun Spot's ArieForce One Coaster for New Park Debut in 2028-2029
articles.summary: Six Flags has purchased ArieForce One, the acclaimed Rocky Mountain Construction coaster previously at Fun Spot, with plans to premiere it at a new park in the 2028-2029 season. The acquisition highlights how large operators are recycling high-value attractions to anchor new destinations. For FEC investors and operators tracking the competitive landscape, this signals continued consolidation and capital deployment by major players.

articles.title: Attraktion! to Supply Two New FlyXD Flying Theaters in Europe for 2027
articles.summary: Attraktion! has confirmed orders for two new FlyXD flying theater installations across Europe, with both set to open in 2027, and will showcase the latest unit at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026. Flying theaters continue to be a high-draw anchor attraction for FEC and entertainment destinations looking to add immersive ride experiences. Operators exploring major attraction additions should track this product's performance and pricing as European demand grows.

articles.title: Imagicaaworld Raises 248 Crore by Selling Hotel Asset to Fund Entertainment Expansion
articles.summary: India's largest amusement and water park operator, Imagicaaworld, has approved the sale of its Novotel Imagicaa hotel for approximately 248 crore rupees to Juniper Hotels, freeing capital for its core entertainment business. The strategic divestiture is a notable example of an entertainment operator shedding hospitality assets to focus investment on its parks and attractions. FEC investors and operators in growth markets should watch how Imagicaaworld deploys this capital.

articles.title: India's First and Largest Indoor Go-Karting Track Commissioned for 24 Crore Rupees
articles.summary: CSML has secured a 24 crore rupee order to design and build India's first and largest indoor go-karting track, a milestone for the country's growing indoor entertainment sector. The project reflects rising demand for premium active entertainment experiences in India's urban markets. FEC operators and go-kart suppliers with international ambitions should monitor India as an emerging high-growth market.

articles.title: New Family-Focused Indoor Entertainment Complex Opens in Mountlake Terrace, Washington
articles.summary: A new family-oriented indoor entertainment complex has opened for business in Mountlake Terrace, Washington, adding to the growing wave of community-level FEC openings across the U.S. The venue represents the ongoing opportunity for operators to serve suburban markets underserved by large entertainment chains. Local and regional FEC operators can use this as a reference point for small-to-mid-scale concept viability.

articles.title: New Indoor Family Entertainment Concept Planned for Denton, Texas
articles.summary: An indoor family entertainment concept is coming to Denton, Texas, adding to the market activity in the North Texas region alongside the Launch Entertainment announcement at Golden Triangle Mall. The growing cluster of FEC openings in the same market is a useful indicator of demand density and competitive dynamics in mid-size Sun Belt cities. Operators evaluating new market entry should consider how multiple FEC formats can coexist in similar trade areas.

articles.title: New LaPorte, Indiana FEC to Feature Bowling, Mini Golf, Arcade, and More
articles.summary: A new indoor family entertainment center is coming to LaPorte, Indiana, offering a multi-attraction format including bowling, mini golf, and an arcade. The venue follows the proven mixed-attraction model that has driven FEC success in suburban Midwest markets. It serves as another data point for operators considering multi-format concepts in smaller regional communities.

articles.title: Why FEC and Attraction Operators Need to Demand More from Their Ticketing Technology
articles.summary: Merac managing director Andy Povey, drawing on 20-plus years as both an operator and technology supplier, argues that ticketing systems should do far more than process transactions — they should drive operational intelligence and personalized guest experiences. The piece challenges FEC operators to hold their tech vendors accountable for delivering actionable data, not just point-of-sale functionality. As guest expectations rise, upgrading ticketing strategy could be one of the highest-ROI moves an FEC can make.

articles.title: ExperienceBank Channel Manager Achieves OCTO Certification for Attraction Ticketing Distribution
articles.summary: DigiTickets' ExperienceBank channel manager has achieved OCTO certification, ensuring standardized real-time connectivity between attraction booking systems and major OTAs like GetYourGuide and Viator. For FEC operators, this means simpler, more reliable third-party ticket distribution without custom integrations. Venues looking to expand their reach beyond walk-in and direct-booking traffic should evaluate OTA distribution as a revenue channel.

articles.title: IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 to Host Largest Education Program in Event History
articles.summary: IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 will feature more than 180 speakers across over 70 educational sessions, making it the biggest education program the event has ever offered. FEC operators, suppliers, and investors attending the London event will have an unprecedented range of learning and networking opportunities. The expanded program reflects the growing complexity and sophistication of the global attractions industry.

articles.title: IAAPA Expo 2026 Reveals Details and Speakers for Signature Sessions
articles.summary: IAAPA has announced the lineup for its 2026 Expo signature sessions, including the Legends Panel, Leadership Breakfast, and Lunch and Learn events. These sessions are among the most attended and influential at the annual gathering, drawing senior operators, suppliers, and investors from across the attractions industry. FEC professionals planning their Expo schedule should prioritize these high-value networking and content events.

articles.title: International Ride Training Launches European Affiliate to Expand Safety and Training Services
articles.summary: International Ride Training has established IRT Attractions Consulting, SLU, a new European affiliate based in Madrid, to better serve its growing client base across the region. The expansion brings specialized operational safety, auditing, and certification services closer to European FEC and attractions operators. As regulatory scrutiny on ride safety increases globally, having access to qualified third-party training and auditing firms is increasingly important for operators.

articles.title: Family Entertainment Center to Open in Former Big Lots Space in Wenatchee, Washington
articles.summary: A new family entertainment center is planned for a former Big Lots retail location in Wenatchee, Washington, continuing the national trend of FECs repurposing vacant big-box retail spaces. The conversion model has proven effective for operators seeking affordable, high-visibility locations in suburban markets. This example is useful for operators and developers evaluating similar adaptive reuse opportunities.

articles.title: Attraktion! Products Installed Across New Polish Adventure Park
articles.summary: Attraktion! has completed a full product catalogue installation at a new adventure park in Poland, demonstrating the supplier's capability to outfit an entire venue with its attraction lineup. The project is relevant for FEC operators and developers looking for single-supplier turnkey solutions for adventure and active entertainment venues. It also highlights Eastern Europe as a growing market for new FEC-style investments.

articles.title: Kaiqi Group Brings Interactive Play Manufacturing to IAAPA Expo Europe 2026
articles.summary: China-based Kaiqi Group, with more than 100,000 square metres of manufacturing space and products in 120-plus countries, is exhibiting at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 with a new generation of interactive play equipment. The company positions itself not just as an equipment supplier but as an end-to-end project partner from concept through installation. FEC operators sourcing play structures and interactive equipment should explore Kaiqi's expanded international offering.

articles.title: Immersive Storytelling Is Reshaping Theme Park and LBE Design Strategy
articles.summary: A detailed analysis argues that the traditional theme park design formula of biggest-fastest-tallest attractions is giving way to narrative-driven, immersive experiences as the primary driver of guest engagement and loyalty. For FEC operators and designers, the shift underscores the growing importance of story, atmosphere, and guest journey in differentiating venues. Operators investing in new builds or remodels should consider how storytelling integration can elevate even modest-budget attractions.

articles.title: Immersive 2.0: How the Experiential Entertainment Genre Is Evolving
articles.summary: An industry analysis examines how immersive entertainment experiences are maturing beyond their first-generation novelty phase into more sophisticated, repeatable formats. For FEC operators considering immersive escape rooms, VR attractions, or experiential zones, understanding this evolution is critical to making sound investment decisions. The piece provides strategic context for operators evaluating where the immersive entertainment market is heading.

articles.title: NRG Adventure Park Moves Closer to Build-Out at Jacksonville's Southside Commons
articles.summary: NRG Adventure Park has advanced through permitting and planning stages toward a full build-out at the Southside Commons development in Jacksonville, Florida. The project represents a significant active entertainment venue addition to one of Florida's largest metro markets. Regional FEC operators and investors should monitor this opening as a competitive development in the Southeast.

articles.title: ProSlide Adds Waterpark Operations Specialist to EMEA Team
articles.summary: ProSlide Technology has expanded its EMEA team by adding Arun Thangaraj, who brings four years of operations experience at Atlantis the Palm, in a technical service support role. The hire reflects growing demand for waterpark expertise in the Europe, Middle East, and Africa region. For waterpark operators and FEC venues with water attractions, supplier technical support capabilities are an increasingly important factor in vendor selection.
